concerns.text: FR-004 says the temporal split is 'train: 2015–2020, validate: 2021, test: subsequent period', while US-2 (acceptance scenario 1), SC-001, and Constitution Principle VII all pin the test set to 2022. 'Subsequent period' is ambiguous (2022? 2022–2023?) and inconsistent with the rest of the document; align FR-004 to 'test: 2022'.

FR-001 and US-1 ingest data for 2015–2023, but every downstream split (US-2, FR-004, SC-001, Constitution VII) ends at the 2022 test year; 2023 is never used anywhere. Either state explicitly that 2023 is reserved/unused, or narrow the ingestion window — the current text implies a scope the modeling sections silently drop.

FR-003 is anchored '(See US-3)', but the first-arrival threshold definition is the core deliverable of US-1 (acceptance scenarios 2–3) and the edge cases; US-3 only sweeps the threshold. The cross-reference misattributes the requirement's primary story anchor.

Edge case 'cumulative count never reaches the 5th observation threshold' is largely unreachable given FR-003 excludes cells with total annual counts < 10 before calculation (any cell with ≥10 annual observations must reach the 5th). Not contradictory, but the edge case should be reworded to the residual case (e.g., cells excluded by the <10 filter) to avoid implying a state FR-003 makes impossible.
